Reply to a bad guest review without making it worse

The problem. A defensive reply, or one that offers a refund nobody agreed, is read by every guest who looks at your listing afterwards.

What you get. Paste the review and what you know. You get a calm public reply, a private message to the guest where it helps and a short list of what to fix. It never offers a refund in public and never uses a fact you marked as unsure.

Get it, $15$15 $7.50 for the first 10 buyers. 30-day refund.

How it was tested

Two invented reviews that were new to us: a mixed one on Vrbo and a harsh, partly unfair one on Booking.com with a refund demand. We read every output for invented facts, promises and private details. The first version argued about reply times, so we changed the rules and re-ran. Claude Sonnet was clean on both reviews.

A small test: two reviews, one run each. ChatGPT free model was weaker in our test, so read every reply. No host has used these replies on a live listing yet.
